LParameters plHabilita

Local lnI

If Type('plHabilita') # 'L'
	plHabilita = .F.
Endif

With Thisform.ParentForm.Pagina.Lista
	For lnI=1 to .Grupo_Op.ButtonCount
		If .Grupo_Op.Buttons(lnI).BaseClass = 'Commandbutton' And .Grupo_Op.Buttons(lnI).Visible
			.Grupo_Op.Buttons(lnI).Enabled = plHabilita
		EndIf
	EndFor
	.cmdFPOper.Enabled = plHabilita
	.cmdMultiSubN.Enabled = plHabilita
	.Grupo_Saida.Sair.Enabled = plHabilita
EndWith

LParameters poForm, pnDataSes

Local lcOperacao

Set DataSession to pnDataSes

Thisform.ParentForm = poForm
Thisform.ParentForm.Enabled  = .F.
lcOperacao = crSigCdOpe.Dopes

With Thisform
	.Caption = 'Operações do Caixa : ' + AllTrim( Proper( crSigCdOpe.Dopes ) )
	.Top     = Thisform.ParentForm.Top + Thisform.ParentForm.Pagina.Lista.Grade.Top + 50
	.Left    = Thisform.ParentForm.Left + ;
			   Thisform.ParentForm.Pagina.Lista.Grade.Left + ;
			   Thisform.ParentForm.Pagina.Lista.Grade.Columns(1)... [TRUNCADO]

Local lcOperacao, lnRecNo, loBrowse

lcDopes = crSigCdOpe.Dopes

If This.Value <> ThisForm.Antvalue
	If Not Empty(This.Value)
		If Not Seek(This.Value, 'TmpOper', 'Dopes')
			loBrowse = CreateObject('fwBuscaSel', 'TmpOper', 'Dopes', This.Value, 'Cadastro de Operações')
			loBrowse.AddColuna('Dopes', '', 'Operação', .t., 'Dopes')
			loBrowse.Show
			This.Value = TmpOper.Dopes
		EndIf
		lcNivels = This.Value
	EndIf
	ThisForm.lhouveAlt = .t.
Endif

If This.Value <> ThisForm.Antvalue2
	If Not Between(This.Value,1,8)
		MessageBox('Informe Sequência entre 1 - 8',0+64,'')
		Return .f.
	EndIf
	ThisForm.lhouveAlt = .t.
Endif

Select crSigMvCxs

If Not Eof() And ( crSigMvCxs.cDopes = crSigCdOpe.Dopes )
	Thisform.lHouveExcl = .T.
	Delete
	Skip
	Skip - 1
Endif

Thisform.GradeSubN.Refresh

If Thisform.cmdInserir.Visible Or Thisform.cmdExcluir.Visible
	If ( Thisform.lHouveExcl Or Thisform.lHouveIns Or ThisForm.lHouveAlt )
		Select CrSigMvCxs
		Go Top
		Go bottom
		Select cNivels,sum(1) From CrSigMvCxs Into Cursor Selecao Group by cNivels having sum(1) > 1
		Select Selecao
		If Reccount() > 0
			MessageBox('Existem Operações Duplicadas!!!',0+16,'')
			Return .f.
		Endif

		Select [ ] as Agrupar,Sum(1) From CrSigMvCxs Into Cursor Selecao where Not Empty(cNivels) And Seqs = 0 group by... [TRUNCADO]

Thisform.lHouveIns = .T.

Select crSigMvCxs
Locate for cDopes = crSigCdOpe.Dopes .and. cnivels = Space(20)
If Eof()
	Insert Into crSigMvCxs (cDopes, CidChaves) Values (crSigCdOpe.Dopes,fUniqueIds())
EndIf

Select crSigMvCxs
Thisform.GradeSubN.Column1.SetFocus
